repo_grounded_facts.statement: NWS site IDs recorded in the gauge registry — NBGI3 (Ohio River at Newburgh Lock and Dam), SHNI2 (Ohio River at Old Shawneetown), MTVI3 (Ohio River at Mount Vernon) — are stage observations, not forecast products. USGS variables recorded: 00065 (gage height), 00060 (discharge).

SCS rainfall-runoff is event-based and empirical: it does not model soil-moisture dynamics, antecedent conditions (AMC I/II/III are not adjusted), or snowmelt. Results are lumped average discharge per timestep, NOT a routed hydrograph.
FORECAST is defined as a modeled value projected into the future — like MODELED but additionally subject to forecast uncertainty; never authoritative.
